bake.ambient: Uniform sky diffuse direct + indirect, color excluded; sun, door and people excluded
bake.ambientEncoding: linear RGB in PNG, no view transform
bake.aoUsage: Separate diagnostic/fallback. Occlusion already present in ambient; do not multiply twice.
bake.variants: Site excludes the changeable building footprint; open variant excludes the removable roof. Both exclude sun, doors and people.

glass: opaque painted diffuse, no reflection or transmission
